title: Verify Parts Technician cannot delete a parts return
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Technician role. (deleting a return requires Invoicing & Payments: Delete per spec v33 / SV-7911; this role has Invoicing = View/Create and Edit, NO Delete - this REVERSES the pre-v33 expectation).
At least one parts return record exists under Parts > Returns.
steps:
1. Click Parts, open Returns, and open a return record.
2. Look for a Delete option; if present, click it.
expected: Deleting the return is BLOCKED: the Delete control is absent/disabled or returns a permission error. (Known failure SV-7911 was raised when this was allowed - retest.)
